simple.meaning: בֶכֶר (Beker) is a Hebrew word meaning “Beker , the name of two Israelites.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶכֶר (H1071) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:21, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶכֶר (H1071) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶכֶר (H1071) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶכֶר (Beker) / H1071 is traced through Genesis 46:21, Numbers 26:35, 1 Chronicles 7:6, 1 Chronicles 7:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
